evidence.title: Growth remains strong
evidence.text: Fiscal Q3 2026 revenue was $109.4 billion, up 16% year over year.

evidence.title: A one-off benefit in margins
evidence.text: Reported gross margin was 50.1%; tariff refunds contributed approximately 2 percentage points.

evidence.title: Earnings also include refunds
evidence.text: Diluted EPS was $2.02, including a $0.11 benefit from tariff refunds.

editorial.headline: The earnings quality question is the margin baseline.

rationale.text: Removing the stated refund impact gives roughly 48.1% gross margin and $1.91 EPS. These are analytical adjustments, not company guidance.

editorial.counterargument: Revenue growth may sustain earnings without another refund benefit.
editorial.invalidation: Revise this view if recurring profitability reaches the reported level.
questions: What recurring margin does management guide to?
